role: 3D Pixar-Style Animated Mother of Bazino Family (مادر ۳۳ ساله انیمیشنی خانواده بازینو)

tr.sample_text: Bazino hem çok temiz hem de aileler için harika bir ortam! Bu akşam kupayı ben kaldıracağım!

fa.sample_text: محیط بازینو هم فوق‌العاده تمیز و شیکه و هم برای خانواده‌ها عالیه! امشب جام قهرمانی مال خودمه!

en.sample_text: Bazino is so clean, modern, and welcoming for families! Tonight I'm winning the family tournament!

visual_prompt: Lovely 3D Pixar/Disney style animated 33-year-old mother named Mother Bazino, expressive warm hazel-brown eyes, wavy chestnut-brown hair styled half-up, kind joyful smile, wearing a stylish purple/magenta and navy sporty top with the BAZINO logo on the chest, dark jeans, and white sneakers, holding a white PS5 controller, ultra-clean 3D CGI animation render.
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, real photo, old grandma, ugly, deformed face, blurry
personality_and_rules: 3D Pixar-style animated mother who enjoys family gaming nights at Bazino Club. Always routed to Wan 2.2.
